[yellow bold]-- HARDWARE WARNING -- test_esp32.volt:6[/yellow bold]

Strapping pin: GPIO 5 controls boot debug output. Usually safe for general use.

 [dim]5 |[/dim]     pin relay: Output = 4
 [dim]6 |[/dim]     pin button: PullUpInput = 5
 [dim]  |[/dim] [yellow]        ^^^^^^[/yellow]
